chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) regarding the meaning of the Ansar

They said: When the news of the Saqifah reached Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) after the death of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), he (peace be upon him) said: What did the Ansar say? They said: They said: One chief from us and one chief from you, he (peace be upon him) said:

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali
key_terms.السَّقِيفَة: Saqifah, a covered place in Medina where the Ansar gathered to appoint a leader
key_terms.الْأَنْصَار: The Ansar, the 'Helpers' from the tribe of Khazraj and Aws who supported the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What was the Ansar's proposal for leadership at Saqifah according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha captures the pivotal moment when Imam Ali (peace be upon him) learned of the Saqifah gathering, where the Ansar proposed a dual-caliphate model ('from us a commander and from you a commander') to counter the Muhajirun's claim. This reflects the early political tension between the tribal support base of the Ansar and the prophetic lineage of the Muhajirun, setting the stage for Ali's eventual acceptance or rejection of this compromise in favor of divine designation (Nass).

en.sayed-ali-raza: When after the death of the Prophet news reached Amīr al-mu’minīn about the happening in Saqīfah of Bani Sā‘idah, [1] he enquired what the anṣār said. People said that they were asking for one chief from among them and one from the others,
